blocks.text: ALBAY — Residents near the slopes of Mayon Volcano were sent to evacuation centers on Friday after a thin layer of ashfall began affecting nearby towns following a “moderate explosive eruption” before noon. Oscar Robert Cristobal, chief of the Albay Public Safety and Emergency Management Office (Apsemo), said they expect to evacuate 1,131 families from Tabaco City, Ligao City and the towns of Guinobatan, Camalig, Daraga and Malilipot, particularly in areas in the 6-kilometer-radius permanent danger zone (PDZ). Cristobal said they have prepositioned food packs and transportation facilities to mobilize the evacuation efforts. READ: BREAKING: Mayon Volcano erupts, sends ash plume […]...
